newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's to pay out 5.75 pound dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's to pay out 5.75 pound dividend.

text.p: Egyptian Portland Tora Cement said on Thursday it would pay a 5.75 pound yield for the 1995/6 financial year.
The firm gave a 4.75 pound dividend for 1994/5. The financial years end on June 30.
The firm, which has a total of 23.841 million shares, said shareholders could pick up their dividend from branches of Misr Exterior Bank starting from December 30.
The state retains 68 percent of the firm while private shareholders own about 22 percent. The employee shareholder association holds 10 percent.
